posts.title: Technology: The state of AI
posts.description: AI is an interesting phenomenon: It is praised as ultimate solution and evil at the same time. This text is an attempt to step outside both positions. The goal is not to defend or attack AI, but to understand it: to explore why it is simultaneously glorified and vilified, and what a more realistic trajectory might look like.

posts.title: Technology: AI & Security - It's Not One Discussion
posts.description: The problem with this topic is that it isn’t one single topic. What I see is multiple distinct discussions rolled into a single convoluted mess. So let me deflate this overheated discourse

posts.title: Technology: The XZ files
posts.description: A Near Miss with Disaster? There are days when you can tell that something has just happened that will leave a lasting mark on your professional world. March 29, 2024, was another one of those days. And this time, the change was not for the better.
